title: Rescuing a Rebase Gone Wrong
description: Recover safely from a rebase conflict by aborting or completing the rebase.
objective: Recover from the interrupted rebase and leave the repository in a clean, valid state.

whatToDo.text: Inspect the repository and understand why the rebase is paused.
Either safely abort the rebase or resolve the conflict and continue.
Leave the repository clean with no rebase in progress.

hints: A rebase in progress can always be safely stopped and reversed if you'd rather start over.
If you want to continue, resolve the conflict, stage the resolved file, and let Git continue the rebase.

intro.message: Amit got stuck during a rebase. Don't panic — Git gives you a safe way to back out, or you can resolve the conflict and continue.

resolveConflict.message: Nice. The conflict is resolved and Git has the changes staged. You're ready to continue the rebase.

abortRebase.message: Good call. The rebase was aborted safely and the branch is back where it started.

success.message: Good instinct knowing you could always back out safely. Either way, we're in a clean state now.

failure.message: The rebase still needs to be recovered. Either abort it safely or resolve the conflict and continue.
